title: A core–shell heterostructured nickel manganese layered double hydroxide@ZnCo2O4 nanocomposite electrode for enhanced asymmetric supercapacitor applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5354-5366
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00863H, Paper
Desta M. Ulisso, Pooja K. Bhoj, Sanjay S. Kolekar, Jaeyeong Heo, Anil Vithal Ghule
A core–shell heterostructured NM-LDH@ZCO/SSM nanocomposite was synthesized by a two-step, simple, facile, and cost-efficient reflux-mediated method, showing enhanced electrochemical performance for supercapacitor applications.
